item.description:
A quicker green button

  • Quick Snap on the green button opens a little sooner when you rest the pointer on it, while still waiting long enough that passing over the button doesn't open it.
  • Choosing a layout now closes the palette instantly, without waiting for the window to finish moving.
  • Busy apps, such as Xcode while it's building, now reliably move when you choose a layout from the green button or drag a window to snap it.
